Implemented the label-aliasing fix in `model/labels/labels.go`.

`Labels.DropMetricName` now creates a separate label slice when removing a non-leading `__name__` label, preventing the original shared backing array from being overwritten. This prevents range evaluations from splitting a series and creating duplicate labels.

- `go test ./model/labels` passed.
- `go test ./model/labels -run TestLabels_DropMetricName -count=1` passed.
- `go test ./promql` ran but failed on an unrelated flaky-looking expectation in `TestEvaluations/testdata/operators.test`: `random + on() metricA` returned `{foo="bar"}` unexpectedly.

Only `model/labels/labels.go` is modified.
